content: We need number of CH3 groups in the compound. But we don't have the compound given. Possibly the sample is the one we have NMR data for? We need to get NMR spectra to infer methyl groups. Could use proton NMR to count methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool. That will give spectrum string. Then we need to interpret? Might be easier: maybe the compound is known from context? No context given. So we must measure NMR. Use proton_nmr_spectra.
